starter.description: Training scene 0, views 0–1, including native hand supervision. Start with scene 0 / frame 0.

zerograsp11b.terms: See the author repository and linked dataset terms.

starter.description: Released training shard 0, containing 100 observations and their native supervision. No extraction is needed.

jacquard.terms: Use is governed by the Jacquard author download terms. Request the full dataset through its official page.

starter.description: Official sample: 10 objects and 48 RGB-D observations with planar targets. Object-disjoint training and validation are created locally.

suctionnet1b.terms: Author non-commercial dataset terms; see the official download page. The source repository has no root license file.

starter.description: Official suction labels only (11 MB download). RGB-D scenes and object models are shared with GraspNet and must be downloaded or linked separately; see Guide → Datasets.

graspgen.terms: Grasp annotations: CC BY 4.0. Objaverse assets retain their individual licenses; see the author attribution list linked in Guide → Datasets.

starter.description: Four original Franka Panda objects: two train and two validation, preserving author split membership. Released grasp labels and original Objaverse meshes; partial depth views are rendered locally. This starter is not the full benchmark.

targo.terms: Author dataset terms apply; TARGO source is MIT. No broader dataset license is declared in the pinned data card.

starter.description: Four original training scenes (58 original grasp trials) and the author test scene. Downloads exact CSV byte ranges and reconstructs its selected rows without changing labels. A base-scene-disjoint split is applied locally.

acronym.terms: ACRONYM annotations and example assets retain author CC BY-NC 4.0 terms; full ShapeNetSem meshes require separate access and terms.

starter.description: Two original NVIDIA examples (Mug and Table), their meshes and 4000 original grasp trials. Toolbox demonstration split: Mug train, Table test. Depth views are generated locally.
